historical_topic_checks.finding: Consistent period; relative peace is qualified, with administrative and guard duties rather than a universal absence of martial obligations.

historical_topic_checks.topic: Rank, privilege, income, heredity and adoption
historical_topic_checks.finding: Presented as variable by rank/domain/resources, with fictional lower-ranking household; no assertion that every samurai was equally rich, poor, or absolutely immobile.
Payment and commutation arrangements explicitly vary; avoids implying every stipend was literal identical bags of rice, while cash needs and borrowing are historically credible.
Continued training and conditional legal privileges are compatible with Edo order; no unlimited right to kill for any insult is claimed.
Marriage, succession, financial management and adoption are treated with explicit variation, without a universal powerless-wife or military-wife assertion.
Correctly identifies lords rather than every retainer as the obliged party, admits exceptions, and distinguishes lords wives/heirs in Edo from every lower-ranking retainers wife.
Masterless status is distinguished from a universal romantic wanderer, criminal, or heroic rebel stereotype.
Avoids a timeless uniform code, universal automatic ritual death for mistakes, and an unsupported single martial curriculum.
